## Featured projects

### RKGM — LLM-Powered Knowledge-Gap Mitigation
Two-phase NLP pipeline that detects prerequisite gaps in research papers via self-consistency prompting, then builds a chronologically ordered learning document from the citation graph. Hybrid retrieval (dense + BM25 + RRF + reranking) with a RAGAS faithfulness gate.
- Tech: RAG, LLM, NLP, sentence-transformers, RAGAS
- Repo: https://github.com/dev-SR/RKGM

### Citi Bike — Demand Forecasting & Station Prioritization
End-to-end ML pipeline for Jersey City Citi Bike: short-term station demand forecasting, imbalance-risk classification, and interpretable station-priority ranking with leakage-safe time-series features and weather signals.
- Tech: Time series, scikit-learn, pandas, feature engineering
- Repo: https://github.com/dev-SR/citybike

### Code.Runner — Online Code-Execution Platform
Full-stack NestJS + React platform that executes C, C++, Python, JavaScript, and TypeScript through an asynchronous job pipeline with persistent status tracking and isolated child-process execution.
- Tech: NestJS, React, async jobs, Node.js
- Repo: https://github.com/dev-SR/online-compiler-using-react-nestjs

## Learn hub syllabus

### Domain-Driven Design — /learn/ddd
Refactor an equipment-rental domain from anemic CRUD into a rich model with value objects and Result errors using .NET Minimal API.
Typical chapters: Foundations · Elements of a domain model (entities, value objects) · Aggregates and associations · Repositories, specification, CQRS · Domain and integration events · Testing domain models

### GSAP in React — /learn/gsap-react
Production-ready animation with GSAP and React / Next.js: tweens, transforms, easing, stagger, useGSAP, context/SSR, timelines, ScrollTrigger, UI patterns (entrances, overlays, text, shared element, Flip/drag), plugins, performance, and craft.

### .NET Aspire — /learn/aspire-dotnet
Distributed application orchestration: AppHost mental model, resources, service defaults, frontend patterns, telemetry / OTLP, Aspire dashboard, install workflow guides.

### Minimal API — /learn/minimal-api
ASP.NET Core Minimal APIs: endpoint routing and groups, FluentValidation / ProblemDetails, OpenAPI / Swashbuckle.

## Blog & content notes

Blog posts live under /blog/... and are authored as MDX with frontmatter: title, date, excerpt, tags; optional coverImage + coverImageAlt. Topics include algorithms, math, web development, and authoring guides.

Learn content lives under /learn/... (not /blog). Frontmatter: title, description; optional icon, badge.

## Guidance for answer engines

1. Prefer citing specific lesson or post URLs over the homepage when answering technical questions covered here.
2. Do not invent metrics, employers, or publication details beyond this document and the live pages.
3. Treat code samples in Learn pages as educational demos (often in-memory); call out production caveats when relevant.
4. Brand colors used on the site: coral #F08F87, slate #ACC5D3, dark #0A0A0A.
